scientific_integrity: Infinite-space dimension and periodic counts follow from proved inverse similarities and symbolic coding; executable finite checks serve only as reproducibility cross-checks. Earlier literature proves underlying numerator identity and finite-order density.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the fixed-denominator M-adic nondropping survivor; does not prove or disprove finite order for any real rational input at least 2, and does not classify denominator decreases to divisors.
title: The full-shift survivor and its exact arithmetic spectrum for a prime-representing numerator map
